items.question: By what count and in what locations are certain beings held in a state of torment?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified.
That count applies within thousands of locations.
Those locations are identified as womb-diagrams.
Beings in those locations are in a tormented state.
items.inference: Beings are tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the tormented beings remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams hold beings in torment.
